fullPassage: Dear Kelly Anderson, I'm glad you're finding our online course on environmental sustainability both engaging and informative! It's great to see you looking into additional resources to further your understanding of the course. For a comprehensive overview, I suggest reading Silent Spring by Rachel Carson, which significantly influenced American environmental policy and awareness. Another excellent choice is Cradle to Cradle by William McDonough and Michael Braungart. This book offers innovative perspectives on sustainable design and production. Also, check out the article Planetary Boundaries by Rockström et al. available through our library. It's excellent for understanding current sustainability issues. Please feel free to reach out if you have any more questions or need further recommendations! Warm regards, Professor Jean White
